svg.title: Developer View: Journey x Test Coverage

g.text: Developer View: Journey x Test Coverage
(green = e2e, amber = unit-only [e2e backlog], red = none, grey = backend/pytest)
("kid profile picker (/kids)" block: no horizontal overflow)
No FUNCTIONAL e2e assertion on the pill's state. It is no longer
unseen by e2e, though: visual.spec.ts routes /v1/profiles/story-status
with an ON fixture, so the "new story!" pill is pinned in the kid
visual baselines. That catches it disappearing, not it being wrong,
so the node stays amber. Before that fixture the endpoint was UNROUTED
and failed closed, and the pill was absent from every baseline: the
surface least covered was the one the visual suite could least see
GREEN • e2e: library.spec (hero+shelf, tap->reader, empty, mobile)
incl. single-book shelf, at desktop/tablet/mobile widths and
+ kid-touch-targets.spec (choice buttons meet the 44x44 WCAG 2.5.5 floor)
GREEN • covered within reader.spec happy path
GREEN • e2e: reader.spec (plays to ending, network disabled)
GREEN • e2e: reader-conflict.spec (both paths; asserts a
conflict-dialog count of ZERO, since newest-write-wins is silent)
NOT reader/dialogs.test: that file only exercises DownloadNeeded,
the iOS post-eviction state, and never touched conflict
GREEN • reader.spec asserts the ending screen
GREEN • e2e: library.spec (rating posts upsert, fills stars)
GREEN • e2e: guardian-auth.spec (successful sign-in, not just the redirect)
GREEN • e2e: intake.spec (submit, PII-free brief, status polling)
no horizontal overflow, incl. user-management table)
+ review-edit.spec (Edit passage save path, reachable + unreachable
+ keyboard-nav.spec (Send Back + Edit passage dialogs, keyboard reachable)
GREEN • e2e: guardian-review.spec (approve, incl. guardian-403 fail-closed)
+ e2e-real: approval-flow.spec (real backend smoke, zero mocks)
Backend, pytest-covered, out of frontend-e2e scope
the guardian console (sign-in, profiles, intake, queue, review,
request loop (WS-B: request, approve/decline, proposed series, anchored
continuations), and the reader 409-conflict reconciliation all have
Playwright coverage; Approve, the authored-request path, and a naive-kid
misuse scenario also have real-backend smoke tests (e2e-real/*.spec.ts,
"Avatar shows new story ready!" pill state is asserted
Not yet recolored on this backbone (INTERIM):
AdultGate steps and the WS-J admin surfaces (user management #267, authoring
queue #268, moderation dashboard/thresholds, provider allowlist) now have their
own e2e specs (listed above), but this journey's step nodes have not been
re-drawn to include them. The same applies to four more surfaces backfilled
2026-07-23 to 2026-07-25 that also fall outside this backbone: the ADR-018 D1
guardian consent gate (guardian-consent.spec), the ADR-016 ring-2 family
surfaces outside the review queue (admin-read-heavy.spec's audit-log and
admin-library lifecycle-filter cases; its review version-compare case IS
folded into "Review a story" above, since that step is on this backbone),
and the WS-J admin CRUD tab touch targets (admin-touch-targets.spec).
guardian-password-reset.spec is the one exception among the 2026-07-23
backfill specs: it is folded straight into the "Guardian signs in" note
above, since it is the same sign-in surface rather than a new step. Treat
this map as current only for the request -> approve -> read loop it
